adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained offset from ~586 to ~642: N drops ~6 mm, E rises ~8–9 mm, U drops ~3–4 mm, then returns toward pre-offset levels after 642. P1 and P2 (single-day) are too short for a platform; P3 spans the sustained shift (587–642) and matches onset/return directionality; P4 and P5 (642–643) reflect the return but are fragmented—P4 aligns with return onset, P5 is likely noise or overfitting. The interior of P3 (587–642) shows persistent offset without motion reversal, supporting a genuine temporary platform. No independent permanent step is evident within this interval. Thus only P3 is a genuine temporary platform.
